name: Asian Paints Ltd
description: Asian Paints Ltd is India's largest paint corporation and ranked among the top 10 decorative coatings manufacturers globally. Operating in 15 countries, the company offers interior/exterior paints, wood finishes, waterproofing (SmartCare), adhesives, and complete home décor solutions including modular kitchens (Sleek) and sanitaryware (Ess Ess).

company_profile.summary: Asian Paints Ltd is India's largest paint corporation and ranked among the top 10 decorative coatings manufacturers globally. Operating in 15 countries, the company offers interior/exterior paints, wood finishes, waterproofing (SmartCare), adhesives, and complete home décor solutions including modular kitchens (Sleek) and sanitaryware (Ess Ess).

revenue_breakup.desc: Interior wall paints, exterior architectural coatings, enamels, and primers.
Modular kitchens (Sleek), bath fittings (Ess Ess), wallpapers, and furniture.
Architectural and protective coatings in South Asia, Middle East, and South Pacific.
Automotive OEM coatings and protective industrial marine coatings.

moats_and_strengths: Legendary supply chain distribution moat delivering directly to 75,000+ retail dealers 3-4 times daily without wholesalers.
Proprietary tinting machine network installed at over 55,000 dealer storefronts across India.
Unrivalled brand equity with Royale and Apex commanding consumer pull and premium pricing power.
Consistently high return on capital employed (ROCE > 30%) and debt-free corporate balance sheet.
company_profile.order_book_or_capacity: Total Manufacturing Capacity: ~2.1M KL/annum across 27 manufacturing facilities

promoter_governance.parent_group: Asian Paints Founders (Choksey, Dani, Vakil Families)

bullish_triggers: Expansion of backward integration plants into vinyl acetate monomer (VAM) and vinyl acetate ethylene (VAE).
Rapid scaling of Beautiful Homes Service transforming Asian Paints into a full-service home décor provider.
Cooling crude oil prices directly lowering raw material costs (titanium dioxide, solvents).
bearish_risks: Aggressive market entry by Grasim (Birla Opus) with heavy dealer incentives and discounting.
Sluggish real estate repainting cycles during prolonged monsoon seasons.

liquidation_safety.pledge_deadline: 9:00 PM on T-day (Mandatory CDSL/NSDL OTP authorization)
